researchNote.id: Katalog ini memuat shorthand prompt khusus pembuatan gambar. Nama kode ditemukan pada referensi komunitas Wishyani dan Arjav Jain, bukan daftar command resmi OpenAI. Contoh visual dibuat dengan Imagegen dari deskripsi cangkir biru fiktif tanpa foto masukan; contoh tersebut tidak membuktikan bahwa kode pendek saja menghasilkan gambar tertentu.
researchNote.en: This catalog contains image-generation prompt shorthands. Their code names were found in the Wishyani and Arjav Jain community references, not an official OpenAI command list. Full prompts were written for this catalog. Visual examples were created with Imagegen from descriptions of a fictional blue mug, without input photos; they do not establish that short codes alone produce a particular image.

id.prompt: Buat satu foto makro persegi yang realistis. Bila ada foto produk terlampir, jadikan bentuk serta warnanya sebagai acuan; tanpa foto, gunakan cangkir keramik biru kobalt matte tanpa merek, berbadan silinder dan bergagang D. Bingkai sangat dekat pada bibir kanan atas cangkir dan sambungan atas gagangnya, sehingga sebagian besar cangkir sengaja berada di luar bingkai. Tampilkan butiran halus glasir keramik dan sorotan lembut di tepi bibir. Fokus tajam pada bibir depan dan sambungan gagang; rongga cangkir di belakangnya serta latar studio krem hangat tampak kabur dengan kedalaman bidang sangat dangkal. Gunakan cahaya samping lembut dari kiri atas, proporsi masuk akal, dan variasi glasir kecil yang natural. Jangan tambahkan retakan berlebihan, cairan, tetesan, teks, logo, watermark, bingkai, kolase, penggaris, label, orang, atau objek lain. Ini ilustrasi sintetis produk fiktif, bukan dokumentasi inspeksi.
id.result: Tekstur keramik pada bibir serta sambungan gagang menjadi pusat perhatian, sementara bentuk cangkir lainnya terpotong dan latar kabur. Contoh menjelaskan arah foto detail; pola glasir tidak membuktikan tekstur atau cacat pada barang sungguhan.

en.summary: An extreme close-up that emphasizes surface texture and small object details against a blurred background.
en.input: Describe the object and the detail to highlight; a product photo is optional. Without one, use the rim and handle attachment of an unbranded matte cobalt-blue ceramic mug.
steps: Choose one small detail to focus on, such as the mug rim or glaze texture; attach a reference photo if available.
Copy the full prompt and adapt the focal point, lighting, and magnification.
Create the image and inspect its shape and texture. Do not treat synthetic details as a real product inspection.
en.prompt: Create one realistic square macro photograph. If a product photo is attached, use its shape and colors as reference; otherwise use an unbranded matte cobalt-blue ceramic mug with a cylindrical body and D-shaped handle. Frame an extreme close-up of the upper right rim and upper handle attachment, deliberately cropping most of the mug outside the frame. Show fine granular ceramic glaze and a soft highlight along the rim. Focus sharply on the front rim and handle joint; let the inner cavity behind them and a warm cream studio background fall out of focus with very shallow depth of field. Use soft side light from the upper left, plausible proportions, and small natural glaze variations. Do not add exaggerated cracks, liquid, droplets, text, logos, watermarks, borders, collages, rulers, labels, people, or other objects. This is a synthetic illustration of a fictional product, not inspection documentation.
en.result: The ceramic texture at the rim and handle joint is the focal point, while the rest of the mug is cropped and the background blurred. The example illustrates a detail-photography direction; the glaze pattern does not establish the texture or defects of a real item.

en.prompt: Create one square stained-glass-panel illustration. If a reference photo is attached, use its main object's silhouette as inspiration; otherwise show an unbranded cobalt-blue cylindrical mug with a D-shaped handle pointing right, in a simple three-quarter view. Keep the entire mug and handle visible with generous margins. Build the mug from translucent cobalt and sapphire glass pieces separated by strong dark lead lines. Its opening is a dark blue oval and the handle opening stays readable. Fill the background with abstract cream and pale amber glass segments and a few muted teal accents. Use luminous backlighting, subtle rippled glass texture, and small bubbles. The overall image should resemble a flat assembled glass panel. Do not add text, numbers, logos, watermarks, an exterior frame, collages, extra objects, or people. The result is an illustration of a fictional panel, not a fabrication cutting pattern.
en.result: The mug appears as blue glass segments with dark divisions, surrounded by glowing warm glass shapes. The example shows glass texture and segmentation; it is not documentation of a real panel or a validated construction design.

en.prompt: Create one square low-poly 3D-style render. If a product photo is attached, use its silhouette and colors as reference; otherwise use an unbranded cobalt-blue cylindrical mug with a D-shaped handle on the right. Reinterpret the body as a roughly twelve-sided polygonal cylinder with an angular rim and a handle built from a few flat segments. Show the entire mug and handle in a three-quarter view, centered on a warm cream surface and background. The mug is empty with its dark blue inner cavity visible. Use clearly visible polygonal faces, discrete changes in shade between adjacent faces, and a crisp geometric silhouette. Avoid smooth rounded surfaces and photorealistic ceramic texture. Use soft studio light from the upper left and a short contact shadow. Leave comfortable margins. Do not add text, logos, watermarks, grids, borders, collages, props, or extra objects.
en.result: The blue mug appears as an angular geometric form with different shades across its faces. The example demonstrates a low-poly look in a raster image; it does not produce a mesh, measured geometry, or a 3D model file.
